# ANALYSIS: STAGE-1-BACKTEST-AND-VALIDATION-PLAN

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT

## Hypothesis

Running the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder will generate new strategy candidates. Subsequent walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) will allow us to evaluate edge capture and aggregate Sharpe, ensuring we only advance candidates that meet the OP-16 threshold.

## Mechanism

1. Execute the autoresearch grinder to produce Stage-1 candidate markdown files in `strategy/candidates/`.
2. For each candidate, run walk-forward OOS backtest (using a held-out window) to compute OOS edge_capture and Sharpe.
3. For candidates passing OOS, run real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) to verify simulator accuracy.
4. Aggregate results to determine which candidates have edge_capture >= 771 and positive aggregate Sharpe.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Cannot assume without backtest results; any claim would be speculative.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 grinder uses historical data; risk of overfit without OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA validation on top 3 J days not yet performed)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Grinder may produce no candidates passing basic filters.
   - OOS may show negative edge_capture for all candidates.
   - Real-fills may show significant slippage vs simulator.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown until backtest results are available.

## Pre-merge gate

- Stage-1 backlog must be processed by the autoresearch grinder.
- Walk-forward OOS must show edge_capture >= 771 and aggregate Sharpe > 0.
- Real-fills on top 3 J days must show < 20% deviation from simulator P&L.
